agent_generation.scenario_mapping_note: 源文件没有 emergency/rescue 标签；应急救援智能体仅从源文件中的火灾、跌倒、入侵、告警、泄漏和交通事故等技能派生，未使用 part2 或外部技能。
agent_generation.column_6_interpretation: 用户列说明跳过第6列；本数据集将其定义为运行环境。

compute_load_processing.node_mapping: sha256(container_ip) mod N; this is not a recovered physical server mapping
compute_load_processing.cpu_metric: source data does not contain CPU utilization; no CPU value was fabricated
compute_load_processing.memory_capacity: synthetic fixed capacities 512/768/1024 GB, used only to estimate used memory
compute_load_processing.gpu_memory_capacity: per-node maximum observed aggregate rounded up to a multiple of 64 GiB
compute_load_processing.model_compute_features: 仅编码 GPU算力剩余量(TFLOPS)、内存剩余量(GB)、显存剩余量(GB)；利用率、队列和 batch 仅保留作数据溯源，不进入模型
compute_load_processing.interpolation: only missing memory utilization and GPU memory usage are interpolated within each node

link_design: 智能体间采用无向全连接逻辑拓扑；每个智能体固定且仅连接一个算力节点；通信边不携带任务依赖，任务依赖只保存在复杂任务 DAG 中
